commits.message:
ENH: Updated Superbuild.cmake and CMakeLists.txt to build an example library named ctkbstestsMyCore.h

ctkbstestsMyCore is build against Qt and CTKCore.

This a very basic test allowing to make sure at least the include directory and the CTK libraries are exposed
properly.
ENH: In CMakeLists.txt, update macro downloadFile. ExternalProject.cmake and FindCTK.cmake are now downloaded from the main CTK github repository.
BUG: Fix CMakeLists.txt, change "CTK_" into "CTKBSTESTS_" and add missing declarations expected by macro ctkbstestsMacroBuildQtLib
ENH: Added macro ctkbstestsMacroBuildQtLib and its related dependencies.

ENH: Add CTestConfig.cmake - The result of ctest will be sent to my.cdash.org/submit.php?project=CTK

The admin of the dashboard will make sure that the machine submitting to the
dashboard will be added under the "BuildSystem Tests" group.

ENH: Add initial structure. The project CTKBuildSystemTests contains one test named cmake_ConfigureAndBuildMyProjectUsingCTKSuperBuildTree
that will make sure CTK superbuild is working properly.

Later one, a test named cmake_ConfigureAndBuildMyProjectUsingCTKSuperBuildInstalltion
will be added.

This framework will also offer the possibility to test different set of superbuild options.
